content.title: Form bharne baithe ho?
content.subtitle: Chhoti galti, bada sardard. Submit se pehle ek baar dekh lo.

steps.title: Naam ki spelling
steps.detail: Bilkul passport jaisa likho. Middle name aur surname ka order bhi wahi rakho.
steps.tip: Har form mein ek jaisa naam, har jagah.

steps.title: Galat email
steps.detail: Wahi email do jo roz check karte ho. University ke saare updates wahin aayenge.

steps.title: Galat program ya intake
steps.detail: Course ka naam aur intake do baar check karo. Milte julte naam wale courses bhi hote hain.

steps.title: Document ka format
steps.detail: Upload se pehle file type aur size ki requirement padho. Scan saaf aur seedha ho.

steps.title: Receipt save nahi ki
steps.detail: Fee payment aur submission ki confirmation ka screenshot aur PDF sambhal ke rakho.

caption:
Application form mein chhoti galti bhi baad mein bada sardard banti hai. Ye 5 galtiyan mat karna 👇

1. Naam ki spelling
2. Galat email
3. Galat program ya intake
4. Document ka format
5. Receipt save nahi ki

Save karo 📌 aur us dost ko bhejo jo abhi form bhar raha hai.

👉 app.goeduabroad.com
